verdict: Yes. Nidhi's Grandmaa Secret from Gurugram pitched natural ayurvedic hair oil on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Hair oiling is a daily habit for many Indians, and a family recipe with a story sells well.
angle: Ayurvedic hair oils are one of India's largest personal care categories. A personal story, clear ingredients and before-and-after content build trust. An AYUSH licence and lab testing are essential.
